items.q: How does BeRanked determine Behance case rankings?
items.a: Our automated scraper simulates organic Behance search queries across all native tags attached to your case. The robot scans search result pages in real time to locate the exact position (Page 1–10, positions #1 to #100) of your case.

items.q: Why do tag search positions change constantly?
items.a: Behance algorithms continuously recalculate project rankings based on fresh views, appreciations, saves, and collection additions. BeRanked tracks these fluctuations 24/7 so you know when a keyword drops and needs optimization.

items.q: Is it safe to use BeRanked with my Behance account?
items.a: 100% Safe. BeRanked operates strictly using publicly accessible case URLs. We never ask for, store, or require your Behance passwords, cookies, or account access.

These are keywords where your project ranks on search pages 2–3. With minor ranking boosts or refreshed engagement, these tags quickly enter the TOP-10, driving the majority of organic search impressions.

items.q: How does 1-Click Multi-Format Tag Export work?
items.a: The Copy Tags dropdown lets you export tracked keywords formatted specifically for Behance case editor (comma-separated), spreadsheet columns (Excel/Sheets), or social hashtags in one click.

items.q: What is Tag Fuel and how is it spent?
items.a: Every automated search scan consumes 1 Tag Fuel credit per checked keyword. You can top up your fuel pack anytime or subscribe to Daily Fresh / Pro Stream for recurring automated checks.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy defines how BeRanked collects, stores, and protects personal data provided by users of the service.
privacy.section1Text: We respect user privacy and comply with global data protection standards (GDPR-aligned). We never sell personal data to third parties.
privacy.section2Text: We only collect essential data: email address for account authentication and publicly accessible Behance project URLs provided by users.
privacy.section3Text: All network traffic is encrypted using TLS/SSL. Passwords and sensitive authentication tokens are hashed using industry-standard cryptographic algorithms.

sections.title: 1. General Provisions
sections.content: This Privacy Policy sets forth how BeRanked ('We', 'Operator') collects, uses, and safeguards personal data submitted by users of the https://beranked.domcraft.digital website and service. We strictly adhere to GDPR principles and data privacy laws.

sections.title: 2. Personal Data We Collect
sections.content: We only collect essential technical and identification information necessary to deliver analytics services: user email address (for authentication and password recovery), hashed credentials, and publicly available URLs of Behance projects submitted for tracking.

sections.title: 3. Purpose of Processing
sections.content: User data is processed exclusively for account management, service delivery, providing real-time ranking data, processing subscription payments via certified acquiring partners, and customer support.

sections.title: 4. Data Storage & Protection
sections.content: All data transmission is encrypted via TLS 1.3 / SSL. We do not store raw credit card details or Behance account passwords. Personal data is never sold or transferred to unauthorized third parties.

sections.title: 5. User Rights
sections.content: Users hold the right to request access to, correction of, or permanent deletion of their personal information at any time by contacting our support team.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Is it safe to use BeRanked for my Behance account?
faq.a1: Yes, 100% safe. BeRanked operates strictly as an external scanner of public search results. We never ask for Adobe passwords or perform actions on your behalf, so there is zero risk of bans or penalties.
faq.q2: How do optimized tags help my project reach the Top and get Featured?
faq.a2: Behance search algorithms prioritize projects with high relevance, search traffic, and user engagement. By tracking accurate ranks, you can replace stagnant tags with high-velocity terms that land on Page 1.
faq.a3: All monitored projects are scanned daily automatically. You always have up-to-date position data and trends on your charts.
faq.q4: Can I import tags directly from Excel or Google Sheets?
faq.a4: Yes! Our hybrid tag input supports column pasting from Excel or Sheets. Paste 50+ tags at once, and the parser cleans and formats them instantly.
faq.q5: How many projects can I track?
faq.a5: The Free tier includes 1 project. For creative studios and active freelancers, Pro and Studio plans offer 5, 15, or more projects with unlimited custom tags.
faq.q6: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
faq.a6: Yes, you can cancel anytime with 1 click in your account settings. All your analytics remain accessible until the end of the paid period.
